general.name: Docker - Configure Host Maintenance [Lin]
general.description: Sets Docker log and build-cache limits and a weekly prune that skips if a needed container is down; never removes volumes or restarts Docker. https://github.com/TechCollective/DattoRMM_Components

variables.name: usrMode
variables.description: Apply makes the changes. Report says what it would change and changes nothing.

variables.name: usrLogMaxSize
variables.description: Per-container log file size before rotation, e.g. 10m (k, m or g). Blank leaves log settings alone.

variables.name: usrLogMaxFile
variables.description: 1-20. Rotated log files kept per container.

variables.name: usrBuildCacheMax
variables.description: Build cache is trimmed back below this, e.g. 100GB. Blank leaves build-cache settings alone.

variables.name: usrBuildCacheReserved
variables.description: Build cache is never trimmed below this, e.g. 20GB. Docker 28+ only; ignored on older engines.

variables.name: usrPruneSchedule
variables.description: systemd OnCalendar for the prune timer, host local time, plus up to 30 min random delay. Blank leaves the timer alone.

variables.name: usrPruneOlderThanHours
variables.description: 24-8760. Only unused items older than this are pruned. 168 = 7 days.

variables.name: usrPruneNow
variables.description: Yes also runs the prune once, now, and reports disk before and after.

variables.name: usrRequiredContainers
variables.description: Optional. Container names, space or comma separated, that must be running or the prune is skipped. Stopped always/unless-stopped containers block it regardless.
